evals.name: supersede
evals.prompt: A new decision changes an earlier one about the lock.
evals.expected_output: Writes a new entry that supersedes the old one and links it. Does NOT edit or delete the old entry.

evals.name: author-vs-pm
evals.prompt: The decision is about publishing to npm.
evals.expected_output: That is reserved to the author: records it as pending the author, not as a PM decision. Never decides it as Kevin.
